glosses: sword (a long bladed weapon with a grip and typically a pommel and crossguard (together forming a hilt), which is designed to cut, stab, slash and/or hack)
spade (playing card marked with the symbol ♠)
épée (fencing sword of a certain modern type)

examples.en: I have the King of Spades.

examples.text: Tom está entre la espada y la pared.
examples.en: Tom is caught between a rock and a hard place.
